findings.evidence: Lines 46–54 construct the positive map using only evaluation, map_add and map_smul; normalization likewise uses no continuity. Mathlib's integral_rieszMeasure (Real.lean:341) takes a positive linear map.
findings.fix: State both for L : C(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ in namespace LinearMap; pass L.toLinearMap from Pietsch.
findings.issue: Both exists_regular_integral_eq_neg (line 43) and exists_isProbabilityMeasure_integral_eq_div (line 59) require StrongDual although continuity is unused, restricting application to algebraic functionals satisfying the stated positivity condition.

findings.evidence: Lines 74–86 use only the upper-bound hypothesis, map_add, map_smul and scalar arithmetic; no continuity property of L is used.
findings.fix: Replace StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) with C(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, move the declaration to LinearMap, and update the caller.
findings.issue: apply_nonpos_of_forall_uniformlyPositive_lt unnecessarily requires a continuous linear functional, although its argument is entirely algebraic.

summary: Three public helpers unnecessarily require continuity of the linear functional.
